method: Built-in image_gen tool with project reference images

concepts.name: Cable-car Welcome
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished STYLIZED 3D CARTOON mobile-game startup/sign-in UI concept for WHATTHE FISH?, landscape.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is the project's actual character art direction: use its large expressive eyes, chunky teal hair, coral/yellow hair accents, compact cartoon athlete proportions and solid three-dimensional modeling. Image 2 is an actual game environment: take the colorful stadium, curved architectural forms, clean grass, puffy clouds and game-render lighting language, NOT its empty camera framing. Image 3 is actual game scenery: take layered rounded limestone, broad palm foliage, teal cable-car structures and tropical boardwalks, NOT realistic texture details. Image 4 is the existing game branding: preserve recognizable "WHATTHE FISH?" spelling, yellow and cyan chunky letters and small friendly orange fish; keep the logo tasteful and not huge.
The USER HAS REJECTED both photoreal fantasy island renders and overly simple flat SVG/cartoon drawings. The exact target is BEAUTIFUL MODELED 3D CARTOON GAME ART with depth, soft contact shadows, rounded modeled geometry, thoughtfully simplified but sufficiently rich scenery, clean diffuse materials, appealing expressive characters, and a designed family-friendly game title-screen composition. It should feel like a crafted 3D game scene closely related to the provided game references. Not a photograph, not an illustration made of flat outlines, not a paper-cut poster, not preschool clipart, not low-effort primitive blocks. No microtexture, skin pores, realistic ocean waves, dramatic cinematic clouds, glare, photorealistic landscapes, excessive depth of field, medieval towers, fantasy mountains, giant balls on buildings, random ornate decorations or generic AI poster chaos. Keep details physically coherent and deliberately organized. Readability and a clear focal point are essential.
DELIVER ONE PRESENTATION BOARD: a large, beautifully composed full LANDSCAPE 16:9 READY menu occupies the upper 80-85% of the board. Below it, a slim pale neutral presentation strip outside the game screen contains the alternative LOADING module only, plus short label "SAME PAGE · LOADING STATE". Do NOT create two tiny full screen duplicates. This makes the art and UI large enough to judge.
IN THE MAIN READY SCREEN: show branded title; two touch-friendly buttons with exact text "Sign in with HUAWEI" and "Continue as guest"; small exact status "Ready to play". These are placeholders; do not render actual account data or forms. Persistent utility controls in top-right safe area with icons AND short labels "English", "Settings", "Info". Comfortable edge margins, no cropped panel or button. Make text clean and correct, no illegible invented type. Buttons have subtle 3D thickness, not excessive gloss; crisp modern playful UI.
IN THE BOTTOM ALTERNATIVE LOADING MODULE: same panel/button region from the main screen, same proportions and visual material, with the login buttons replaced by a progress track at 68%, exact text "Preparing your islands..." and "68%". Short caption "Login appears here when loading finishes." Preserve the main screen behind it in implementation; this is one page changing state, not a game lobby or sport selection.
World premise remains four sports islands (football, basketball, golf, fishing) linked by cable car. This concept precedes the existing main menu; don't copy any current menu or gameplay HUD. No watermark.
CONCEPT: CABLE-CAR WELCOME. Composition within main screen: scenic ground-level three-quarter view at a sunny tropical cable-car boarding platform. A lovely substantial rounded teal-and-cream cabin and ONE cheerful teal-haired athlete based closely on reference 1 occupy the left half. Athlete is waving naturally beside the cabin, wearing sporty teal/white shorts outfit and chunky yellow-accent sneakers. The cabin has believable simple windows, cream posts, a softly rounded wood roof, readable silhouette and a cable overhead; close detail is modeled rather than texture noise. A few rounded palms and gentle distant low islands sit across calm turquoise water. Puffy modeled clouds. Playful polished 3D, like the actual game's character art. Title modestly in upper-left/upper-middle sky.
RIGHT half: a clean warm-ivory panel with softly rounded corners and a subtle sea-green side edge, vertical stack with "Ready to play", sunny yellow "Sign in with HUAWEI", light seafoam "Continue as guest". Quiet positive space around the panel. Keep all utilities above it. The main scene has a coherent horizon, cheerful daylight, no photographic water. Bottom strip shows this panel's loading variant. Small outer board caption "CABLE-CAR WELCOME".

CONCEPT: ISLAND PLAYGROUND. Composition within main screen: a carefully art-directed three-quarter elevated view of exactly FOUR charming modeled island playgrounds arranged in a broad shallow crescent, with the central foreground left empty for the menu. All have LOW, ROUND, SANDY SHORES rather than towering cliffs. One contains a miniature version of the game's colorful curved football stadium; one a compact colorful basketball court; one gently rolling golf terrain and rounded pale limestone; one a friendly fishing lagoon and wood jetty. Soft simplified palms with wide modeled leaves, puffy smooth clouds, bright grassy volumes and calm opaque turquoise water with a few stylized ripple marks. They should have enough crafted 3D detail to feel like an actual game environment, yet remain unambiguously cute cartoon models. One short teal cable-car cabin moving along coherent cables. No human characters in this concept. No oversized balls on top of islands. Not realistic travel scenery.
Game logo centered in upper sky at moderate scale. A wide ivory UI dock centered along bottom of main screen: small "Ready to play" above two broad SIDE-BY-SIDE buttons, warm coral "Sign in with HUAWEI" and mint "Continue as guest". CONCEPT: CREW GETAWAY. Composition within main screen: a close, inviting STYLIZED 3D character-led tropical sports holiday scene on the RIGHT half. Two charming compact cartoon athletes (based on reference 1's face design and 3D construction) stand casually on a broad rounded boardwalk platform with a leafy palm, simple chunky station shelter, and a few rounded flowers. One has teal hair with coral/yellow tufts and holds a football by the hip; the other has warm dark hair with a sporty visor and a neatly held fishing rod. Expressive friendly faces with large eyes but coherent anatomy and poses, sculpted hair clumps and colorful sports shoes. Real 3D volume and soft shadows, no realistic pores or cloth microtexture. A small golf bag and basketball sit naturally beside the shelter, not floating. Distant cable car and simple low island silhouettes behind them. Color palette mint/teal, warm apricot, buttery cream. Artfully composed medium-detail game rendering; not an empty minimalist drawing and not a photoreal 3D advertisement.
On the LEFT half: existing game logo above a generous clean cream welcome area integrated into the composition, small "Ready to play", dark teal softly raised "Sign in with HUAWEI" button, then warm cream teal-bordered "Continue as guest". Large readable type, clear hierarchy, no dashboard-style card grid. Utilities aligned at the upper-right over quiet sky. The left UI and right characters should balance naturally with 6% safe margins. Bottom presentation strip shows loading variant of the same left-hand UI area. Small outer board caption "CREW GETAWAY".
